title: Bind the selected MOVE24472 to permanent HOME fields with a paid packet interface and restored tape owners
body:
## Result
A literal paid interface splits six Gamma codes and complete DATA, invokes the unchanged selected MOVE24472, and restores the same HOME and tape owners. Full time/history bounds are proved under the original entry promises.

## Checks and limits
82,813 transplanted instructions; full 14,495,822-step packet; six negative controls; separate sparse interpreter and two written reviews. Formatted input, numerical/cutoff admission and complete caller integration remain premises. No new kappa; all five global assumptions remain.
